title: The Thief's Stone
journal: Never-Writes-Twice sent me after the three seal-stones. A dead thief's stone lies in the warden's vault at Blackrose Prison, whose people, the Blackguards' heirs, attack strangers on sight. Their gate-captain stands outside the gate. I'm to get in: as a guest past the gate-captain (a toll, words or a duel), unseen past the walls, or by force.
objectives: Get into Blackrose Prison; the gate-captain stands at the gate. (marker: Corvus Ulvius, Blackrose Prison)

plan.going: I am a Reel-Ka of the Toh-Reel-Ka, hunting the three seal-stones that open the kings' gate at Teku-Sul before the Unbound get them. One lies in the warden's vault in Blackrose Prison. The prison's people attack strangers.
plan.next: get into the prison; the gate-captain outside the gate is the first person to deal with
plan.ways: pay the gate-captain 300 gold, persuade him (Speech 75) or duel him until he yields: each makes me a guest, and the garrison stops attacking me; or slip past the walls unseen (Sneak, Invisibility), and they attack if they see me; or fight my way in (any fighting skill), and the whole garrison fights me

answers: I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka (Never-Writes-Twice is my officer). The Hist trees are sick and I need three seal-stones to open the gate at Teku-Sul Spire to reach the Eye of Argonia. The Unbound are racing me for them.
Get into Blackrose Prison and take the thief stone from the warden vault in Raj-Kaal Hall, held by raj-kaal Okaz-Teel who keeps the key on his belt.
As a guest past gate-captain Corvus Ulvius: pay 300 gold, persuade him with words, or duel him. Or sneak over the walls unseen (risky, fair game if caught), or force.
I do not fully understand how I get the vault key from Okaz-Teel, or who the Imperial buyer in the hall is. I could find out by talking to people inside.

title: The Thief's Stone
journal: I got into the raj-kaal's hall without the gate-captain's leave. If a guard sees me, the whole garrison will attack. The vault's key is on Okaz-Teel, the Naga raj-kaal. I'm to get the stone unseen: lift the key from him or pick the vault's Expert lock. Or I can fight him and take the key from his body.
objectives: Take the seal-stone from the Warden's Vault unseen, or by force. (marker: Door to Warden's Vault, Okaz-Teel)

plan.going: I am inside unseen; the garrison is still hostile and attacks if it sees me
plan.next: get the stone from the warden's vault
plan.ways: pickpocket the key from Okaz-Teel, pick the Expert lock, or fight him and take it from his body

answers: I slipped into Raj-Kaal Hall unseen. The seal-stone is in the Warden Vault here; Okaz-Teel the Naga holds the key. Ennodius Vanin the Collector is here too, he wants the vault contents.
Take the stone from the Warden Vault unseen.
Pickpocket the key from Okaz-Teel, pick the Expert lock on the vault door, or fight Okaz-Teel (the whole garrison would then attack).
Nothing new; I do not know what Vanin is up to in here, I could talk to him.

title: The Thief's Stone
journal: I took the thief's seal-stone from the warden's vault in Blackrose Prison. Two stones are still out, in the flooded vaults of Gemin and the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, and both are still marked. I'm to take them.

plan.going: I took the thief's seal-stone from the warden's vault in Blackrose Prison. Two stones are still out, in the flooded vaults of Gemin and the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, and both are still marked. I'm to take them.
plan.next: nothing more in this quest; the next quests entry carries the step

answers: NOTES: I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka (officer Never-Writes-Twice, Helstrom). I need three seal-stones for the gate at Teku-Sul Spire to reach the Eye of Argonia and heal the sick Hist trees; the Unbound (Cuts-the-Old-Knot) are racing me. I now hold the Seal-Stone of the Kings from Blackrose Prison, got by slipping past the gate-captain, lifting the vault key from Okaz-Teel unseen and opening the Warden Vault. Ennodius Vanin the Collector was in the hall.
Next, get the stones from the flooded vaults of Gemin (walk from Jal-Veesa, rootworm) and the deepest hall of Vorannuhl (near Noota Nara, by boat), then return to the Spire.
Still unknown: why the Unbound seal trees they drain, and what moans in Fort Chalkmoth cellar; I could find out by further investigation.
